# htmx v4 API Reference

> Complete bilingual API, attribute, HTTP header, event, extension, and CLI reference for htmx v4.0.1.

## Catalog

- [htmx v4.0.1 API Surface Overview](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/00_overview.html): htmx v4.0.1 (htmx.org@4.0.1) is a zero-dependency, fetch()-powered hypermedia library that extends standard HTML with declarative request attributes…
- [Core Request Attributes](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/01_core_request_attributes.html): The core request attributes declare that an HTML element issues an asynchronous HTTP request when triggered. In htmx v4.0.1, you can declare requests using…
- [Trigger & Synchronization Attributes](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/02_trigger_and_sync_attributes.html): Trigger and synchronization attributes control when an element initiates an HTTP request, whether it requires explicit user or programmatic confirmation, and…
- [Target & Swap Attributes](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/03_target_and_swap_attributes.html): Target and swap attributes govern where server-rendered HTML fragments are placed in the DOM, which swap or morph algorithm is applied, how out-of-band…
- [Data, Validation & Configuration Attributes](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/04_data_and_config_attributes.html): htmx v4 provides declarative attributes for assembling request parameters, injecting custom HTTP headers, enforcing HTML5 constraint validation, tuning…
- [UX, History, Events & Inheritance Control Attributes](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/05_ux_history_and_control_attributes.html): htmx v4 refines how progressive enhancement, browser history restoration, in-flight loading states, untrusted content isolation, inline event scripting, and…
- [HTTP Request & Response Headers](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/06_http_headers.html): htmx v4 communicates rich client context to the server via HX- HTTP request headers and empowers the server to drive client-side navigation, DOM retargeting…
- [JavaScript API & TypeScript Interfaces](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/07_javascript_api.html): While htmx is designed around declarative HTML attributes, htmx v4.0.1 exposes a focused JavaScript API on the global htmx object for programmatic AJAX…
- [Configuration Options & CSS State Classes](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/08_configuration_options.html): htmx v4.0.1 is configured declaratively via a tag in (supporting both HCON and JSON syntax) or programmatically via the global htmx.config object…
- [Events & Extension Hooks Reference](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/09_events_reference.html): htmx v4.0.1 standardizes all DOM lifecycle events around a colon-delimited htmx:phase:action naming convention (replacing htmx 2's camelCase event names such…
- [Streaming & Network Extensions](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/10_extensions_streaming_and_net.html): htmx v4.0.1 provides six first-party extensions for persistent server-to-client streaming (hx-sse, hx-ws, hx-multipart) and network transfer optimization…
- [Reactive Scripting & DOM UX Extensions](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/11_extensions_reactive_and_dom.html): htmx v4.0.1 includes hx-live (htmx.live) for fine-grained DOM-native reactive expressions, state proxies, and async UI choreography, alongside five…
- [Security, Compatibility, Internal API & CLI](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/en/12_extensions_security_compat_and_cli.html): This catalog page documents the security, caching, and compatibility extensions (hx-csp, hx-history-cache, hx-prompt, hx-alpine-compat, htmx-2-compat), the…
